name: adv_dqn_bad
title: DQN with a replay buffer and a target network - seven planted defects
origin: written for the domain-generative-rl-graph hardening round, 2026-09-13
note: The three defects an RL reviewer cares most about - the target network that is never synchronised, the TD target that keeps its gradient, and the replay buffer that is fed from the evaluation episodes - have no rule in the catalog and are recorded under `unsupported`.

expected.why: the parameter and module registries are never built, so .parameters() is empty and the optimizer trains nothing

expected.defect: the value and advantage branches live in a plain dict
expected.why: neither duelling head is registered, so both stay at their initialisation while the body trains
the body carries nn.Dropout(0.2), so the greedy policy being measured is not the greedy policy

expected.defect: the evaluation episodes are not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: an autograd graph is built for every environment step of every evaluation episode

expected.defect: both networks are moved with an unconditional .cuda()
expected.why: nothing in the workspace calls torch.cuda.is_available(), so the script raises on any CPU-only machine

expected.defect: torch.load passes neither weights_only= nor map_location=
expected.why: it unpickles arbitrary objects and fails on a machine without the device the checkpoint came from

expected.defect: nothing seeds torch, numpy, random or the environment
expected.why: epsilon-greedy exploration, the replay sampling and the initialisation all move, so two runs of this script are not comparable

forbidden.why: learn() calls optimizer.zero_grad() at line 93, before loss.backward() at line 94
the order inside learn() is zero_grad (93) -> backward (94) -> step (95)
the only no_grad block is the epsilon-greedy forward at line 79; loss.backward() at line 94 is outside it
no loss is accumulated across iterations - learn() returns loss.item()
there is no cross-entropy loss in this project; the TD loss is F.smooth_l1_loss
there is no binary cross-entropy in this project
there is no train/test split call in this project - the data is the replay buffer
there is no DataLoader in this project at all
there is no DataLoader in this project at all
there is no DataLoader in this project at all

unsupported.defect: the target network is never reloaded from the online network; SYNC_EVERY only gates a print
unsupported.why: no rule models `a second model instance that is constructed, loaded once and then never re-synchronised`. This is the highest-value RL-specific defect in the file and the catalog cannot express it.

unsupported.defect: the bootstrap target is not detached, so gradients flow through the target network
unsupported.why: no rule models `a value produced by a second model reaching a loss without .detach()`.

unsupported.defect: the evaluation episodes are pushed into the replay buffer the agent learns from
unsupported.why: MLV107 (test set used for model selection) is a later-tier rule and would in any case not see a replay buffer; nothing in the catalog models `the held-out interaction is fed back into training`.

unsupported.defect: both networks are on CUDA but ReplayBuffer.sample() returns CPU tensors
unsupported.why: MLV501's documented detection needs `the batch loop`, and this project has no DataLoader-driven loop for it to anchor on.
